widgetTool.name: show_bill_breakdown_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a donut card on chat of what the latest bill is made of (gas supply, delivery and other lines). Use it after get_bill_breakdown when the caller is on chat and asks what their bill includes; on voice, say the same in short sentences. Pass the card field of get_bill_breakdown as is. Values come only from that tool. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-bill-breakdown-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-bill-breakdown-card (the card element this tool renders).

display_text.description: Optional. The short on-screen text of the reply: one short sentence naming the largest part and its amount. The website shows it instead of the long spoken text. Dollar amounts and dates are written in bold markdown (**$12.50**, **November 7, 2026**). The card never repeats this text.

items.description: Bill parts that add up to the total.

label.description: Name of the part, for example Gas supply.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Write this text as the full spoken explanation, exactly as a person would say it on a phone call: plain natural spoken sentences, built only from the tool results and nothing invented, that say every fact the card shows once (the card is never repeated afterwards). Say every amount, percentage and date in words (for example forty-one dollars and one cent, the twenty-sixth of October), never digits, dollar signs or symbols, and say a year in words too (twenty twenty-six); a confirmation or claim number is the one exception and is read as returned in short groups. Use no emoji, markdown, bullets, tables, symbols or line breaks, because the voice may read this text aloud. Say the total of the bill first, then every item of the card with its amount, largest first, in everyday words. The short on-screen text goes only in display_text of the card payload (always pass it, written in the customer's language; digits and symbols are allowed there): one short sentence naming the largest part and its amount. This text is the whole reply, so write no other text and no separate pacing sentence. When the tool call failed there is no card and the text stays short.
